// Run when one dies: counts it for the quest WolfQuest (stage 1). Generated by build_regions.py
01	Get.Value	ATTRIBUTE	WolfQuest	Variable.1$
02	>Conditional	$Variable.1=1	13
03	Get.Value	ATTRIBUTE	WolvesSlain	Variable.2$
04	>Conditional	$Variable.2<6	13
05	Update.Attribute	WolvesSlain	+1
06	Get.Value	CALCULATION	$Variable.2+1	Variable.2$
07	>Conditional	$Variable.2<6	10
08	Display.Message	Yellow	Wolves slain for the shepherd: $Variable.2 of 6.
09	End
10	Quest.Note.Done	WolfQuest	Slay six wolves on Greymoor.
11	Quest.Note	WolfQuest	Tell the shepherd in Moorcross.
12	Display.Message	Yellow	Six wolves! Tell the shepherd in Moorcross.
13	End
